in_scope.text: The engine as described at system level: the weights every token needs stay in memory; all experts stay on storage in a file prepared so that one expert is one contiguous read; a cache in memory holds the most used experts; a routed expert that is not cached is read from storage for that step and may replace a less used one; reading starts as soon as routing is known and overlaps with computation of experts already in memory.

The engine description contradicts the given model on the routing it must implement.
